data.title: Bitcoin Cracks $78,000 and Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin May Be 'About To Explode'
data.description: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) on Friday picked up momentum to reclaim $78,000 for the first time in three days, while Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) followed higher to touch $2,500.XRP (CRYPTO: XRP) climbed above $1.30, while Dogecoin (CRYPTO: DOGE) jumped roughly 6%.Ripple Chief Legal Officer Stuart Alderoty said…
